purpose: One fixed paired test of stock-specific intercepts, against pooled and per-stock historical-frequency baselines
limitations: Development years have already been inspected; this paired hypothesis is not a fresh holdout.
All observations after 2023 are excluded before feature creation, encoding, baseline fitting and model fitting.
Current surviving symbols omit delistings and point-in-time membership changes.
One-hot categories and stock priors are learned only from each purged fitting fold. Unseen stocks use an all-zero identity and the pooled baseline prior.
The model adds regularized stock intercepts, not separate stock-specific slopes or time-varying fundamentals.
A higher hit rate at different coverage is not proof of improvement; every year and every starting phase must pass unchanged cost, coverage and drawdown gates plus the additional stock-prior gate.
Current adjusted histories are not vintage snapshots. Labels overlap and block-close drawdown misses intrahorizon losses.
No parameter, threshold, seed, window or symbol subset is selected after observing these results.
A development pass permits shadow review only; no daily-model promotion or trading.
